title: Improving Sample Complexity of Critic-Actor Algorithms
abstract: arXiv:2510.04189v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: There has been significant research activity on studying the theoretical convergence guarantees (both asymptotic and non-asymptotic) for actor-critic (AC) algorithms. In a couple of recent papers, two-timescale critic-actor algorithms have been proposed where the role of the actor and critic is reversed, resulting in the algorithm mimicking value iteration as opposed to policy iteration. Finite time analysis has been carried out for a two-timescale critic-actor (CA) algorithm with function approximation and a sample complexity of $\mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-(2+\delta)})$ is obtained for some $\delta>0$ that is a function of the separation between the two step sizes. In this paper, we obtain improved sample complexity of $\mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-2})$ that had previously been achieved only by the single-timescale actor-critic algorithm. translated_title: 改进Critic-Actor算法的样本复杂度
translated_abstract: 关于actor-critic（AC）算法的理论收敛性保证（包括渐近和非渐近保证）已经有大量的研究。在最近的两篇论文中，研究者提出了双时间尺度的critic-actor（CA）算法，其中actor和critic的角色被颠倒，使算法模仿值迭代而非策略迭代。已有工作对采用函数逼近的双时间尺度critic-actor算法进行了有限时间分析，得到了 $\mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-(2+\delta)})$ 的样本复杂度，其中 $\delta>0$ 是取决于两个步长之间分离程度的参数。本文获得了改进的样本复杂度 $\mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-2})$，这一复杂度此前仅能由单时间尺度的actor-critic算法实现。我们为actor和critic的递归提出了改进的学习率，从而得到了这一更优的样本复杂度。
tldr: 本文通过为actor和critic递归设计改进的学习率，将双时间尺度critic-actor算法的样本复杂度从 $\mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-(2+\delta)})$ 提升至 $\mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-2})$，达到了此前仅单时间尺度actor-critic算法才能实现的水平。
en_tdlr: This paper improves the sample complexity of two-timescale critic-actor algorithms from $\mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-(2+\delta)})$ to $\mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-2})$ by proposing modified learning rates for the actor and critic recursions, matching the complexity previously achieved only by single-timescale actor-critic algorithms.
